claim: Joint two-sided aggregation lower bounds past the 11x11 frontier (F-24/F-27 follow-up): LB_3(12,13)=36, LB_3(13,12)=36, LB_3(13,13)=52 (all proven CP-SAT optima, hence valid lower bounds on T_3); LB_3(12,12)=18 revalidated; on the (k,7) row LB_3(12,7)=0 and LB_3(13,7)=2. Discriminator runs at FGGP OBS_3 boundary sizes all consistent with the true FGGP statement (OBS_3 = minimal NON-3-colorable grids, Def 1.4 + Thm 6.1/6.5 of arXiv:1005.3750, full text verified 2026-11-12): a session brief had G_13,7 as rect-free, which the model refutes — OPTIMAL lb=2 at (13,7) is impossible if a rectangle-free coloring existed, since every real coloring is a feasible point of the relaxation.
tool: tools/joint_relax.py (joint two-sided aggregation relaxation, F-27 build, used unmodified)

note: All identities in the joint model are exact on real colorings, so every proven optimum is a valid LB. The 13x7 result contradicts the session brief's reading of FGGP and matches the paper itself: OBS_3 is the obstruction (non-colorable) set, so G_12,7 is rect-free (LB 0) and G_13,7 is not (LB 2). Orientation symmetry of the joint model confirmed at 12x13/13x12 (both 36).
